Presented by Dr Robert Séror Mercurius Iodatus Ruber (Bin-iodide of Mercury.) Again, if in a Merc . patient with diphtheria, tonsillitis, etc., the inflammation and pain begin on the left side, and incline to remain there or spread to the right, the bin-iodide is indicated. These two iodides have more rapid and greater induration beneath ulcers and chancres than Merc ., and in old syphilitics the iodides are sometimes more useful.
